response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates strong distributed systems experience, deep Python/TypeScript proficiency, and direct exposure to AI-agent infrastructure at re:cinq — aligning well with the role’s AI-native engineering focus. His ownership mindset, operational experience (CI/CD, on-call readiness), and cross-functional collaboration history are compelling. Minor concerns include limited explicit mention of Python in recent roles and no clear evidence of agile scrum champion rotation experience.
strengths: Proven experience with AI-agent infrastructure and agentic code generation at re:cinq
Strong distributed systems background with high-throughput, low-latency systems (e.g., DLang, microservices at Dunnhumby)
Demonstrated ownership via open-source projects, DevOps setup, and full-stack operational responsibility
concerns: Recent resume lacks explicit Python projects — primary language shown is TypeScript/Node.js
No clear evidence of rotating scrum champion role or formal agile ceremony leadership
German language skill is basic, which may limit stakeholder alignment in Berlin-based teams
